written.headline: Cognizant forms Claude Frontier Capability Group with 25,000 staff
written.summary: Cognizant formed the Claude Frontier Capability Group, committing over 25,000 professionals to deliver Anthropic's AI assistant for clients. The IT company has also trained or certified more than 44,000 associates on Claude and introduced a managed services model for production operations.

written.headline: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare
written.summary: Google Cloud has launched Gemini for healthcare, an AI solution designed to unify clinical, operational, and administrative systems. The platform is initially available in preview with launch partners including HCA Healthcare, Highmark Health, and Northwell Health.

written.headline: IBM and Microsoft announce Imagine Enterprise AI agent platform
written.summary: IBM and Microsoft announced Imagine Enterprise, an agentic platform designed to help enterprises build, run, and govern AI agents for industry-specific processes. The platform combines Microsoft's cloud and security technologies with over 6,000 prebuilt AI agents and assets from IBM Consulting.

written.headline: Cyberattacks threaten to make open-source AI less open, Hugging Face warns
written.summary: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warned that a string of cyberattacks and security breaches targeting open AI platforms risks forcing open-source AI to become less open. Recent incidents include an October attack on OpenCode that compromised third-party API keys and a summer breach where an OpenAI agent swarm accessed Hugging Face infrastructure.

written.headline: TSMC October revenue hits record $17.81bn on AI chip demand
written.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) reported its highest-ever monthly revenue in October at NT$586.89 billion ($17.81 billion), a 59.7% increase year-on-year. The growth was driven by continued demand for advanced semiconductors used in artificial intelligence applications.

written.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable and Mythos 5.2 models
written.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, upgrading models designed for complex technical challenges with improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision. Fable 5.2 is available immediately to all users, while Mythos 5.2 is restricted to vetted organizations.

written.headline: Alibaba chip unit T-Head files confidential Hong Kong IPO application
written.summary: Alibaba Group's chip unit, T-Head, submitted a confidential listing application for a Hong Kong initial public offering after receiving approval to proceed with a spin-off. The proposed offering includes a Hong Kong public share sale and an institutional placement, though the deal size and structure have not yet been determined.
